documentReferences.label: Master Comment Report - AW OWB Review

findings.comment: Water Benchmarking Application has been submitted but contains unresolved deficiencies. OWB review comments (OWB2, OWB7, OWB8, OWB9) show pending status with corrections required to GFA consistency and irrigated landscape area values. Director approval of the Water Benchmarking Application is a mandatory pre-release condition per LDC 25-9-413(A); application must be corrected and approved before site plan release.

No documentation of 911 Addressing verification or address confirmation is present in the application package. While an Addressing Plan (Sheet 29) is included in the plan set, there is no verification letter from 911 Addressing or Austin Development Services Addressing Review confirming that the address '3759 Valley View Road, Austin, TX 78704' has been verified prior to final approval.

Affidavit of No Liens has not been provided. This is a required document for all site plan applications as an administrative intake requirement, separate from LDC 25-1-81 which governs who may file an application. The affidavit must be provided for the application to be complete.

Plan set does not include the required plan modification threshold note stating that modifications moving a structure more than 25 feet or increasing height or square footage will require Planning Commission and/or City Council review. This standard plan note must be added to the plan notes block on all sites requiring this notation per LDC Chapter 25-5.

Plans do not include an explicit use notation in the plan notes block. While the proposed use (multi-family townhomes) is referenced indirectly in other notes (commercial and multi-family recycling ordinance compliance, parkland dedication for 39 residential units), there is no standalone note explicitly stating the proposed use. Whether this level of implicit use identification satisfies the requirement, or whether an explicit 'Use: Multi-Family Townhomes' notation is required, cannot be determined from available documents.

findings.comment: Asbestos pipe note is present on Sheet 18 but does not comply with General Site Plan Notes Note #25 requirements. The existing note requires work plan review and coordination with City Building Services Department but does not explicitly require the mandatory 30-day advance contact with City of Austin Asbestos Manager before disturbance. The note must be updated to include the 30-day advance notice requirement as specified in the General Site Plan Notes Note #25.
